ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: PRC Anti-Money Laundering Law (revised 2024, effective 1 January 2025), PRC Foreign Investment Law (effective 1 January 2020), PRC Company Law (2023 revision), PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3 (Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information of Legal Persons and Other Organizations, effective 1 November 2024), PBOC Administrative Measures for Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing, and SAFE rules on foreign-invested capital contributions. Taiwan-source corporate documents are authenticated for evidentiary use but do not override PRC UBO filing obligations for

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Act of Taiwan (Taiwan Company Act), as amended and consolidated; Articles 1 through 8, 15, 17, 18, 128 to 138, 156, 161, 172, 192, 208, 218, 218-1, 387, 389 and 393; Regulations Governing Registration of Companies; Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals; Petroleum Administration Act; Environmental Impact Assessment Act; Fire Services Act; Occupational Safety and Health Act; and Money Laundering Control Act, all as applicable to a wholly foreign-owned limited liability enterprise engaged in wholesale brokerage of marine fuel oil and refined petroleum distillates.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (Taiwan), Company Registration Division; with investment project screening separately performed by the Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (Taiwan).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Company Incorporation Registration under Article 387 of the Taiwan Company Act, together with the Foreign Investment Project Application prescribed under the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is required under the Taiwan Company Act. The proposed capital must nevertheless be reasonably correlated with the stated business plan for ISIC 4661 energy commodity trading, and must be supported by an inward remittance certificate from a Taiwan bank and a certified public accountant capital verification report. No blocked escrow account requirement is imposed by the general company registration regime; however, the Investment Commission may require source-of-funds disclosure and may restrict withdrawal or transfer of contributed capital until the approved investment project is confirmed. If the project includes physical fuel storage, the Petroleum Administration Act licensing authority may require additional financial capacity evidence, insurance bonds, or environmental remediation security.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, THAT the following actions are hereby approved and adopted as the first order of business of the Board of Directors of the Company, a wholly foreign-owned enterprise organized under the Taiwan Company Act. FIRST, SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION AND ISSUANCE: The Board acknowledges receipt of the subscriptions for the initial registered capital of the Company, comprising ordinary shares fully paid in cash by the sole shareholder, and ratifies the allotment and issuance of such shares. The Chairman and the Chief Financial Officer are directed to ensure that the share subscription and paid-in capital are recorded in the statutory share register and verified by an independent certified public accountant. SECOND, REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION: The Board approves the adoption of the registered office and principal place of business located at the address stated in the incorporation application and authorizes the execution of the office lease, the engagement of a registered agent if required, and the filing of the registered office declaration with the Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan. THIRD, BANKING AUTHORIZATION: The Board authorizes the opening of operating, foreign-currency, standby letter of credit, and receipt and payment bank accounts with one or more licensed Taiwan commercial banks, and authorizes the Chairman, the General Manager, and the Chief Financial Officer, acting in pairs, to execute account opening forms, mandate instruments, wire transfer instructions, standby letter of credit applications, foreign exchange declarations, and all ancillary banking documents, subject to the Company Anti-Money Laundering and Internal Control Policy. FOURTH, STATUTORY OFFICER APPOINTMENTS: The Board appoints the Chairman and legal representative, the General Manager and principal officer, the Company Secretary and compliance officer, and the Chief Financial Officer, each to hold office until the next general meeting or until earlier resignation or removal in accordance with the Articles. The Board directs the filing of each officer name, national identification, address, and authority with the Ministry of Economic Affairs. FIFTH, GENERAL POWERS AND RATIFICATION: The Board authorizes the officers to prepare, sign, notarize, file, and prosecute all registration applications, petroleum enterprise licensing filings, environmental screening submissions, fire safety approvals, tax registrations, banking notifications, and employment registrations necessary to commence lawful operations. Any lawful action taken by the officers prior to the adoption of these resolutions in furtherance of the Company incorporation and licensing is hereby ratified and confirmed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Foreign Investment Project Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (Taiwan); Company Name Registration System operated by the Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (Taiwan).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit through the MOEA Company Registration and Investment Commission one-stop electronic portal a name reservation application and a foreign investment project application under the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals. The filing must identify the applicant as a wholly foreign-owned limited liability company, propose a Chinese and English company name, describe the primary business as wholesale brokerage of marine fuel oil and refined petroleum distillates under ISIC 4661, list all shareholders and beneficial owners, state the proposed capital in New Taiwan dollars and foreign currency, designate the registered office address, and attach legalized corporate existence documents of each foreign shareholder. The authority will publish the proposed name for a public objection period and simultaneously screen the investment plan for national security and public-interest concerns. Once approved, the applicant obtains a name reservation certificate and an investment project approval letter, which must be presented to a Taiwanese bank before any inward capital remittance is made.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate structure and beneficial ownership identification
Certified copies of foreign shareholder incorporation certificates or passports
Proposed Chinese and English company names and business scope
Foreign investment project application form
Capital schedule, remittance plan and source-of-funds evidence
Registered office letter of intent or preliminary lease
Foreign shareholder board resolution authorizing formation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name reservation is refused, the applicant must obtain the written refusal reason, modify the proposed name to remove prohibited or confusing elements, and submit a new name application without additional fee. If the foreign investment project is queried or suspended, the applicant has the right to submit supplementary legalized documents and rebuttal memoranda within thirty days; if the suspension is final, an administrative appeal may be filed with the Ministry of Economic Affairs, followed by administrative litigation in the Taipei High Administrative Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution, Notarization and Legalization of Incorporation Instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan notary public; Taiwan overseas representative office or apostille authority in the foreign shareholder jurisdiction; licensed translator approved by Taiwanese courts.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed Taiwanese attorney and certified public accountant to finalize the articles of incorporation and the share subscription agreement. Execute a written shareholders resolution appointing initial directors and fixing the share allotment. All signatures of foreign shareholders must be notarized by a Taiwan overseas mission or verified through apostille issued by the competent authority in the shareholder home jurisdiction, with Chinese translations certified by an approved translation agency. The articles must contain the company name, corporate objects, registered office, authorized and paid-in capital, share classes, board size, director powers, and indemnification provisions. Verify that each director satisfies the qualifications under the Taiwan Company Act and that no director is disqualified by reason of bankruptcy, criminal conviction, or a subsisting violation of the Petroleum Administration Act or Money Laundering Control Act. Deliver sealed originals and certified translations to counsel in Taiwan.
required_dossiers: Draft articles of incorporation in Chinese and certified English translation
Share subscription agreement executed by all shareholders
Written shareholders resolution appointing initial directors
Director consent and assumption of duty forms
Notarized or apostilled powers of attorney for the Taiwanese applicant
Certified translation of all foreign corporate and personal documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarization is rejected, cure the deficiency by obtaining a supplementary apostille, judicial authentication, or Taiwan diplomatic mission certification, and resubmit the documents. If translation certification is challenged, engage a court-approved sworn translator to reissue the translation. Any defect in director qualification must be cured by replacement director appointment before the incorporation filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Incorporation Filing and Capital Verification with MOEA
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (Taiwan) Company Registration One-Stop Service; Central Bank of Taiwan Foreign Exchange Department for remittance declaration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the incorporation registration package to the Department of Commerce, MOEA, through the Company Registration e-Form portal after the approved capital is actually remitted into a Taiwanese bank account and a certified public accountant has issued a formal capital verification report. The application must be accompanied by the name reservation certificate, investment approval letter, articles of incorporation, shareholders resolution, board consent, registered office lease or owner consent, director identification documents, and proof of payment of filing fees. The Department will examine the statutory requirements, assign the company registration number, and issue the certificate of incorporation. The registry system simultaneously transmits data to the taxation authority for tax number assignment and to the local municipality for business certificate purposes. Any statutory deficiency notice must be answered electronically before the registration docket is closed.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate and foreign investment approval letter
Paid-in capital inward remittance certificate issued by a Taiwan bank
Certified public accountant capital verification report
Articles of incorporation signed and sealed by all shareholders
Shareholders resolution and first board resolution
Registered office lease agreement or owner consent
Director identification documents and proof of legal capacity
Receipt of state filing fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or suspended, the applicant must respond through the electronic deficiency notice system within the period fixed by the registrar. Corrected forms, supplementary board resolutions, or replacement documents must be uploaded with the deficiency response. If the registry issues a final refusal, the applicant may file an administrative appeal with the Ministry of Economic Affairs within thirty days and thereafter seek judicial review in the administrative court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Business License and Municipal Company Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance (Taiwan); Local Municipal Government Department of Economic Development; Central Bank of Taiwan for business foreign exchange reporting.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After incorporation registration, attend an interview or submit an online application to the National Taxation Bureau of the Ministry of Finance for tax identification number, business tax registration, and uniform invoice registration. Then apply to the local municipal government Department of Economic Development for the company business registration certificate and local licensing endorsement. Because the company will engage in energy commodity trading and will use standby letters of credit and SWIFT wire payment rails, the tax authority may require the applicant to register the overseas trading counterparties and file transaction-level records under the commercial accounting law. The company must maintain complete accounts, issue lawful invoices for brokerage commissions and physical supply transactions, and file monthly value-added tax returns. The municipal business certificate will not be issued until the tax registration, site inspection, and municipal regulatory requirements are satisfied.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation issued by the Ministry of Economic Affairs
Tax registration application and uniform invoice system certificate
Director and shareholder identification documents
Bank account opening certificate
Anti-money laundering compliance manual and internal control statement
Certified business plan for ISIC 4661 wholesale brokerage of marine fuel oil and distillates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is delayed, the applicant must supply the missing documents, amend the business classification to correctly identify ISIC 4661, and request expedited review of the uniform invoice application. If the municipal business certificate is suspended, cure any zoning or fire safety defect by submitting proof of building use compliance and reapply; an administrative appeal may be filed with the local government within thirty days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Special Petroleum Enterprise Operating License under the Petroleum Administration Act
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bureau of Energy, Ministry of Economic Affairs (Taiwan); local municipal fire authority for petroleum storage site approval.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply to the Bureau of Energy, Ministry of Economic Affairs, under the Petroleum Administration Act for the Oil Enterprise Operation Permit covering the wholesale and distribution of marine fuel oil, crude oil, refined petroleum products, and distillates. The application shall include evidence of valid incorporation, financial capacity, product liability and environmental insurance, storage tank capacity or contracted third-party tankage agreements, handling and transfer procedures, product quality specifications, import or export program if applicable, safety data sheets, and a written seal management and anti-money-laundering compliance plan. In coordination with the local fire and environmental authorities, the Bureau will verify the applicant premises, fuel storage facilities, vapor recovery systems, and emergency response plan before issuing the permit. The permit is conditioned on the operator maintaining monthly statistical filings, cooperating with market inspection powers, and using licensed transport and storage contractors where physical fuel handling occurs.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation and tax registration
Petroleum enterprise operating license application form
Evidence of marine fuel oil and refined petroleum products trading scope
Storage capacity schedule or contracted tankage agreements
Product quality specifications and distillation data
Third-party liability and environmental insurance certificate
Facility layout and fire protection plan
Board resolution appointing authorized petroleum compliance officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Bureau of Energy requires further information, the applicant must file a written supplement within the stated cure period, including corrective engineering or insurance documentation. If license approval is denied, the applicant may request reconsideration by the Bureau of Energy, then administrative appeal to the Ministry of Economic Affairs, and ultimately administrative litigation in the competent administrative court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental Impact Assessment, Civil Defense Fire Clearance and Workplace Safety Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Environment, Taiwan; local Fire Bureau under the Fire Services Act; Occupational Safety and Health Administration, Ministry of Labor (Taiwan); local civil defense coordination office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the environmental screening application for the ISIC 4661 petroleum trading project to the Ministry of Environment before commencing physical operations. If the project is limited to brokerage and does not include tank storage, file an environmental registration declaration and obtain acceptance; if the project includes petroleum storage above the regulatory threshold, prepare the appropriate category environmental impact assessment report. Submit the site fire safety plan to the local Fire Bureau and obtain a fire safety certification confirming compliance with the Fire Services Act, including automatic detectors, fire extinguishing systems, emergency exits, dangerous goods separation, and hydraulic flow calculations. Obtain from a licensed structural engineer a load and seismic inspection certificate for any pressure vessels, tanks, and pipe racks. Submit the workplace hazard assessment, confined space entry program, and emergency response plan to the Occupational Safety and Health Administration, and obtain the civil defense clearance and major accident prevention endorsement before beginning fuel handling or storage operations.
required_dossiers: Environmental screening application for ISIC 4661 project
Environmental impact assessment report if required by screening decision
Fire protection design plans and fire equipment schedule
Structural load and seismic inspection certificate for petroleum facilities
Workplace hazard assessment and material safety data sheets
Confined space entry and emergency response procedures
Major accident prevention plan and civil defense coordination agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the environmental screening determines that a higher category of assessment is required, the applicant must follow the determination, provide additional baseline data, or submit an abatement plan. Deficiencies in fire safety certification must be cured by installation of approved equipment and re-inspection. Workplace safety suspension may be cured by retraining, engineering controls, and a successful follow-up audit; final adverse actions may be appealed under the Administrative Appeal Act and thereafter in the administrative court.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Bureau of Energy, Ministry of Economic Affairs (Taiwan); Industrial Development Administration, Ministry of Economic Affairs (Taiwan); local municipal Department of Economic Development; local Fire Bureau; Ministry of Environment, Taiwan.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Petroleum Enterprise Operation Permit and Petroleum Wholesale Business Registration License issued under the Petroleum Administration Act of Taiwan, together with a municipal petroleum products wholesale dealing endorsement.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full Environmental Impact Assessment Report (Category A) where combined petroleum storage capacity exceeds ten thousand cubic meters; Environmental Registration (Category B) for below-threshold storage or transfer facilities; Exempt for pure brokerage operations without physical storage, subject to occupational safety and civil defense clearances.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater oil and grease not more than ten milligrams per liter, pH between six and nine, chemical oxygen demand not more than one hundred milligrams per liter, and suspended solids not more than thirty milligrams per liter; vapor recovery system removal efficiency at least eighty-five percent for volatile organic compounds; fugitive component leak concentration not exceeding ten thousand parts per million methane equivalent; hazardous waste containers must be labeled, manifested, and stored no longer than ninety days unless exported or treated under an approved Ministry of Environment plan.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certification issued by the local Fire Bureau certifying automatic alarm and extinguishing systems, fire walls, hazardous material separation, emergency exits, and evacuation plans; structural engineer inspection and load certification for fuel tanks, pressure vessels, and pipe racks; Occupational Safety and Health Administration approval based on workplace hazard assessment, confined-space entry control, personal protective equipment, monitoring equipment, and a major accidental release prevention plan coordinated with civil defense authorities and the local emergency response command center.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; electronic taxpayer filing through the STA Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax) portal
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The CN WFOE is a PRC resident enterprise, not a non-resident branch. Step 1: incorporate the Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) as a limited liability company with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and obtain the Business License, which includes the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC). Step 2: the USCC constitutes the statutory TIN and is automatically synchronized to the STA; however, the entity must complete supplementary tax registration on the e-Tax portal within 30 days of establishment, appoint a tax accountant/representative, and register for VAT and export tax rebate status if exporting. Step 3: no separate TIN certificate is issued under the one-license-one-code system. For a foreign non-resident shareholder or counterparty without a Chinese establishment, the withholding agent files a non-resident tax registration via the e-Tax portal to obtain a non-resident TIN for China-source income. For the Taiwan trade lane, a pure export sale does not require a Taiwan tax ID; a Taiwan permanent establishment or branch would require separate registration with the Taiwan Ministry of Finance tax collection authority.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. PRC law does not provide a check-the-box or hybrid entity election for a WFOE; the WFOE is mandatorily taxed at entity level as a PRC resident enterprise. For indirect tax, the WFOE may elect small-scale VAT payer treatment if annual taxable sales do not exceed RMB 5,000,000, but must become a general VAT taxpayer once turnover exceeds that threshold. No hybrid mismatch election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: China Value-Added Tax (VAT) under the Value-Added Tax Law of the People's Republic of China and its implementing regulations
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: General VAT taxpayer registration is mandatory once annual taxable sales exceed RMB 5,000,000; every WFOE with taxable sales must complete VAT tax registration regardless of turnover, while below the RMB 5,000,000 threshold the WFOE may remain a small-scale VAT taxpayer.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The WFOE must issue invoices through the STA tax control system and the Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoices (FD-E-Invoice) platform; invoice data is transmitted to the STA in near-real time under the Golden Tax Phase IV system, with API-based issuance for system-to-system integration, digital authentication, and anti-fraud digital stamping. Only invoices cleared through the STA platform are valid for input VAT deduction or export rebate claims.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The 0% VAT export zero-rating is available only for marine fuel oil and refined distillates that are physically exported from mainland China customs territory, with title passing to a non-mainland buyer and export customs clearance evidenced by the customs release. Bunker fuel supplied to international voyages under customs-supervised bonded procedures may qualify as an export when actually shipped to an outbound vessel. The WFOE must be a general VAT taxpayer to obtain the export rebate; small-scale taxpayers receive exemption without rebate. Pure brokerage services without physical export do not qualify for zero-rating.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Goods Declaration for Exportation) bearing customs release stamp
Bill of Lading or seaworthy waybill for the exported crude oil/refined products
Bank receipt or Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) evidencing foreign-currency proceeds received from the overseas buyer
Export tax rebate application filed through the STA e-Tax export rebate module
Certificate of origin or inspection certificate required by the Taiwan buyer, if applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Tax and customs authorities cross-check customs declarations, bank FX receipts, and invoice data. If the zero-rating claim is unsubstantiated, the refunded VAT is clawed back, a late-payment surcharge of 0.05% per day is assessed, and administrative penalties may be imposed under the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Tax Collection. Fraudulent export refund claims of high value can trigger criminal liability, retrospective adjustment across open tax years, and loss of future export rebate eligibility.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The People's Bank of China (PBOC), operating through the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), is the central monetary and foreign-exchange authority for the PRC-incorporated WFOE; the Taiwanese parent's capital remittances are treated as foreign direct investment into mainland China and require SAFE registration.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMB is convertible for current-account purposes subject to genuine trade documentation, but full capital-account convertibility is not yet achieved. A China-incorporated WFOE with Taiwanese shareholders may open foreign-currency capital accounts only after SAFE foreign-exchange registration for foreign direct investment is completed at the receiving bank. Once registered, current-account items such as trade settlements, commissions, and profit remittances are generally available against a real transaction, while capital-account items including capital increases, equity transfer proceeds, offshore loans, and cross-currency swaps remain subject to SAFE approval or registration and are not freely available. Export receipts must be repatriated into Chinese banks and cannot be left offshore without SAFE authorization; they may be retained in foreign currency or converted into RMB in whole or in part at the enterprise's discretion. Profit remittance to the Taiwanese parent is possible only after the annual statutory audit, corporate income tax filing and settlement, withholding-tax payment on dividends, and submission of the board resolution, audited financial statements, tax vouchers, and the remitting bank's transaction forms. The central constraint is not an absolute prohibition but the need to demonstrate the economic substance and documentary chain behind each cross-border fund movement.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For a PRC-domiciled WFOE in commodity wholesale, all export foreign-currency proceeds must be repatriated into the PRC banking system within the SAFE-prescribed trade-monitoring cycle. The receiving bank must record the receipt in the Trade Monitoring System and match it to the corresponding customs declaration. Unmatched receipts are escalated after 30 days, and receipts remaining unreconciled for 90 days beyond the export date trigger high-risk trade-behavior monitoring unless the WFOE provides a written explanation. There is no universal mandatory conversion percentage; the statutory obligation is repatriation and traceability, not mandatory surrender. The exporter may retain qualifying proceeds in a foreign-currency settlement account or sell them to a licensed bank at its election; for the crude-oil and refined-products trading book, the bank may additionally require an enhanced documentary package, including bill of lading, customs export declaration, cargo inspection certificate, and broker commission statement.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: Not viable as the WFOE's principal treasury account or FX execution venue. Offshore digital EMIs such as Revolut Business, Airwallex, and Wise are not licensed as domestic deposit-taking institutions by PBOC or CBIRC and cannot maintain a RMB basic deposit account, an FDI capital account, or an external-debt account for a PRC WFOE. These EMIs cannot file SAFE balance-of-payments reports, cannot issue China-standard account-opening documentation packages, and are not participants in the onshore FX clearing system. They may be used only by the Taiwanese parent as an offshore collection vehicle before funds are remitted into the WFOE's domestic licensed bank. For capital calls, margin calls, and physical petroleum settlements into and out of the WFOE, only licensed domestic Chinese banks are permissible clearing rails.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For this high-risk petroleum wholesale WFOE, physical presence is mandatory. The PRC-appointed legal representative and the ultimate beneficial controller must attend the account-opening interview in the bank branch; remote consular proxy or video-only onboarding is not an accepted substitute under the PBOC AML and account-management rules. Taiwanese-resident statutory directors who are not legal representatives may provide a notarized board resolution and a limited power of attorney, but the controller's face-to-face verification is normally still required. In exceptional cases a bank may permit a consular legalized proxy for non-signatory shareholders, but not as the primary mechanism for a special-license energy commodity trader with a foreign parent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity in the Taiwanese parent's beneficial ownership chain and nominee-shareholder layering around the WFOE capital structure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a notarized and apostilled beneficial-ownership declaration, the Taiwanese parent's full shareholder register from the Ministry of Economic Affairs, articles of incorporation, minute book, bank references, passport or national-ID copies of each ultimate natural person, a clear organizational chart to the final natural persons, and, if the parent is listed, the audited annual report and current shareholder registry. For non-listed parents, provide court/notary attestation of the ownership chain and a certificate that no shelf-company or nominee arrangement exists.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money-laundering red flags in crude-oil and marine fuel transactions: off-market pricing, over/under-invoicing, third-party payments, and documentary mismatches between cargo quantity and invoice volume.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Supply the master sales and purchase contracts with INCOTERMS, the contractual pricing formula or published price benchmark (Platts, Argus), independent inspection reports from SGS, Intertek, or a licensed surveyor, the vessel name/IMO number, bill of lading, cargo manifest, customs declarations, freight agreement, and a signed broker commission schedule. Reconcile every third-party payment with a written assignment or intercompany letter and maintain transaction-level bank screenshots demonstrating no undisclosed intermediary.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions exposure through vessel, charterer, bank, or counterparty touchpoints in the marine bunkering and distillate supply chain, including possible ship-to-ship transfers or high-risk provenance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver a sanctions-screening report covering OFAC, UN, EU, and Chinese authorities for all counterparties, banks, vessels, IMO numbers, and owners, a completed vessel-tracking statement, Port State Control clearances, P&I insurance certificates, a certificate of origin for each cargo parcel, and a detailed transaction map showing loading port, discharge port, and all intermediate ship-to-ship or storage locations. Include a board-approved sanctions compliance attestation and a commitment that no payments to or from restricted jurisdictions are made without license.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Uncorroborated source of wealth and funds for the inbound FDI paid-in capital, particularly rapid tranched remittances from Taiwan that could indicate round-tripping or undocumented lending.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit the Taiwanese parent's audited financial statements for the last 12 to 24 months, bank statements showing the provenance of the remitted funds, shareholder resolution approving the capital injection, the FDI contract and SAFE-registered foreign-exchange registration form, tax return or dividend certificate if the source is accumulated profits, and a capital-verification report from a licensed PRC CPA after the funds land. If any portion of funds originates from a loan, attach the executed facility agreement, repayment schedule, and financing records to evidence lawful external borrowing.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route the Taiwanese parent's remittance as a SWIFT MT103 wire,

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ordinary shareholders' meeting: business report, financial statements, and earnings-distribution proposal submitted for statutory approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company records retained at the registered office; no periodic authority filing required, but the minute book and recognized statements must be produced for inspection by the Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) upon request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after fiscal-year end; for calendar-year companies, no later than June 30 of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to hold the annual shareholders' meeting triggers administrative fines under the Taiwan Company Act; repeated non-compliance may lead to court-ordered shareholder meetings and, in exceptional cases, MOEA-ordered dissolution for an inactive company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Annual Income Tax Return with current-year financial statements and earnings report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance, local jurisdiction of the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar year, the filing period runs from May 1 through May 31 of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharges, late-payment interest, estimated assessment by the tax authority, and collection enforcement; prolonged non-filing may lead to suspension of tax registration and trigger MOEA strike-off procedures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory-register and beneficial-ownership confirmation under Company Act Article 22-1
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company maintains the current register; any change in directors, managers, 10% or more shareholders, or actual beneficial owners is filed with the MOEA Company Registration Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual verification at or before the annual shareholders' meeting; change registrations must be filed within 15 days of the triggering event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or update the beneficial-ownership register is subject to administrative fines and daily penalties; MOEA may publish the non-compliance and, if prolonged, treat the company as non-functioning for strike-off purposes.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Special petroleum wholesale-brokerage license annual compliance report if required by the license conditions under the Taiwan Petroleum Administration Act
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Bureau of Energy, Ministry of Economic Affairs, and any municipal authority designated under the license
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: As specified in the license conditions, typically with the annual financial statements or by the license anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: License non-compliance may result in warning, suspension, revocation, or non-renewal of the petroleum wholesale-brokerage authorization; continued operation without a valid license is an administrative and potentially criminal offense.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: CPA audit and certification are compulsory where the WFOE's paid-in capital reaches or exceeds NT$30 million or where the company satisfies the MOEA-prescribed large-enterprise scale thresholds; the petroleum trading special license may independently impose a mandatory audit and audited financial statements for submission to the licensing authority.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Commercial Accounting Act, Commercial Accounting Treatment and Financial Reporting Standards, and Taiwan GAAP; IFRS is not mandatory for a non-issuer private WFOE unless elected or required by the special license.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Once a year, the WFOE must compare the register of shareholders, directors, managers, 10% or more shareholders, and actual beneficial owners against current facts; the confirmation must be documented in board or shareholders' meeting minutes. Any change must be filed with MOEA within 15 days, and the register remains open for inspection by competent authorities.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard 25% rate applicable to WFOE; no specific tax holidays or preferential deductions for energy commodity brokerage unless qualifying under foreign investment guidance catalog

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Return Form (企业所得税纳税申报表), filed electronically via State Taxation Administration e-filing portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within five months after fiscal year-end (31 December)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross sales of refined products and brokerage commissions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; WFOE reports China-sourced income only

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating costs, interest, and administrative outlays

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty RMB 1,000 per day, capped at RMB 10,000; non-filing leads to business license suspension

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% under China-Taiwan DTA for dividends remitted to Taiwan parent
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit DTA application to Chinese tax authority with Taiwan TRC, beneficial ownership declaration, and Form for Treaty Relief; obtain pre-approval before remittance
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties 6.5% under treaty; interest 10% (reduced to 7% if connected party)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: RMB 100 million annual related-party transactions triggers mandatory Local File and Master File
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China anti-avoidance rules require economic substance; WFOE must maintain real operations and decision-making in China

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to apply arm's length pricing or maintain TP documentation for intra-group oil trades
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty 50% of understated tax; criminal sanctions for willful evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for penalties and possible imprisonment

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to withhold 10% dividend WHT on remittances to Taiwan parent
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty 1-5 times evaded tax plus back taxes and interest
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal restitution obligations and potential criminal liability

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Inadequate due diligence on oil trading counterparties or failure to file suspicious transaction reports
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to RMB 500,000; license revocation and criminal prosecution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines and imprisonment for gross negligence

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating WFOE without genuine business substance for tax avoidance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Transaction recharacterization, back taxes, and penalties up to 5 times evaded amount
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Corporate veil piercing; directors face civil restitution, travel bans, and imprisonment
